Name: More Seed Info
Author: mahsouto
Description:
[center][size=6][b]More Seed Info – Smart Seed Tracker[/b][/size][/center]


[size=4][b]Overview[/b][/size]
With [b]More Seed Info[/b], that hassle is gone: just hover over any seed and see instantly how many you have in your backpack and in your chests —vanilla or mod‑added alike. Organized by season with colorful tabs, you’ll know right away whether it’s worth buying that exotic purple cauliflower or saving your gold for later. If you hate wasting time running back and forth and forgetting what you already bought, [b]this mod is for you[/b].

[size=4][b]Key Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Intelligent Filtering[/b]   
[list]
   [*]Shows only seeds you possess   
[*]Automatic scan of inventory & chests   
[*]Accurate in‑game names (supports all seed mods)
   [/list][*][b]Seasonal Tabs[/b] – Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter 
[*][b]Real‑Time Counts[/b] – Inventory & Chest displayed side by side
[*][b]Shop Tooltips[/b] – Hover in Pierre’s or JojaMart to see your stock
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size][list=1]
[*]Download More Seed Info.
[*]Extract the “MoreSeedInfo” folder into `Stardew Valley/Mods/`.
[*]Launch and press [b]K[/b] (configurable) to open the seed tracker.
[/list]

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
[code]
{
"ShowSeedInfoInShops": true,
"ShopTooltipX": 10,
"ShopTooltipY": 10,
"SeedWindowToggleKey": "K"
}

[/code]
